value.rationale: Total fragmentation and the count of isolated two-vertex components are natural network statistics; the exact finite covariance and its nonzero sign-changing sparse limit distinguish dependence regimes. The sharp log(3/2) location equals the density maximum of order-two components, while 1-(1+c^2)e^-c encodes dependence from conditioned total circle length. The result is an interpretable second-order structural law, not an arbitrary parameter substitution.
